errors.name: InvalidBookDataError
errors.description: Raised when a book's ISBN is not unique or the published_year is invalid.

errors.name: DuplicateMemberEmailError
errors.description: Raised when a member's email already exists in the system.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a member with the given ID is not found.

errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a book with the given ID is not found.

errors.name: LoanNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a loan with the given ID is not found.

errors.name: InsufficientCopiesError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to borrow a book with zero available copies.

errors.name: OverdueLoanError
errors.description: Raised when a loan is already overdue and cannot be renewed.

errors.name: InvalidLoanStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid status is provided for a loan.

errors.name: InvalidMembershipStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid status (e.g., non-boolean) is provided for membership.

errors.name: MalformedCSVError
errors.description: Raised when a CSV file is malformed or cannot be parsed.

errors.name: InvalidInputError
errors.description: Raised when input data is invalid for any operation (e.g., non-integer IDs).
